title: Effective Joint Sato-Tate Distribution and Sign Change of Symmetric Power Coefficients
summary: We prove an unconditional, effective joint Sato--Tate distribution for the Fourier coefficients of two twist-inequivalent, non-CM newforms $f$ and $f'$. Our result generalises a result of Thorner, which holds for rectangular regions, by extending it to any measurable region of $[-2,2]^2$ whose boundary consists of finitely many continuous curves of finite length. As a consequence, we develop a unified framework to study various arithmetic properties of Fourier coefficients of symmetric power $L$-functions attached to $f$ and $f'$.
